subject.title: Seed design system for OpenClaw Windows Hub

question: Should `.agents/design/` mirror current native WinUI as owned derived guidance, or define an intentional future-state redesign, and who owns synchronization?
rationale: The three parity defects are mechanically repairable, but code review cannot determine whether a second Copilot-consumed UI authority belongs in the repository or which source should remain canonical.

options.title: Mirror Current UI
options.body: Correct the parity defects, state that native XAML/C# is canonical, assign a synchronization owner, refresh the branch, and prove every export.

options.title: Define Future State
options.body: Keep deliberate differences only after labeling them as approved prospective design language and assigning ownership for applying them to the app.

options.title: Keep Native Sources Only
options.body: Decline the parallel design surface and retain native code, tests, and existing documentation as the sole UI contract.

recommendation.title: Mirror Current UI
recommendation.body: Correct the parity defects, state that native XAML/C# is canonical, assign a synchronization owner, refresh the branch, and prove every export.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed catalog primarily models the native composer and timeline design where git history shows the strongest ownership.
